notes.title: Achievements, quality-of-life updates, improved graphics options, and more!
notes.content: [p][/p][list][*][p]Added steam achievements 	[/p][/*][*][p]Major randomization rework and improvements[/p][list][*][p]TLDR - improved randomization mechanics, making random abilities occur much more reliably. Previously, the game used a "true randomization" system - this created some annoying situations where what you would see over time did not always line up with the perceived chances - while technically "correct" - and thats the nature of statistics, it could be frustrating. We added various "pity mechanics" to make sure for example a 10% chance is much more reliable - you will get (at least) a 1 in 10 draw of that thing, no matter what. Various other improvements generally make it so what you expect to happen when you think "20% chance" is more likely to be what you see happen, with more reliable passive ability, evolution, and ability triggers. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Specific unit stats and war supplies can now be enabled/disabled for quickspend in order to fully customize how to auto spend your money	[/p][/*][*][p]Units should now attack targets they are suited for and distribute damage rather than ganging up in targets, creating a much more reliable distribution of damage. 	 	[/p][/*][*][p]Added a list of all locations (sorted by tiers, with a collapsible header per tier) and their status (road built, outpost built, building icon if applicable, level x/y, and distance from current position) when on the map panel and not selected on a location. This allows you to see a much better overview of your world progress.  	[/p][/*][*][p]Added new graphics options (anti-aliasing) and adjusted existing ones (soft shadows low/med/high are greatly improved) 	[/p][/*][*][p]Fish bones and adventure coins show up in merchants for a cost in gems, allowing you to purchase relics and artifacts without having to play these modes if you don't want to (albeit at a slower rate). [/p][/*][*][p]Added option for auto move to prioritize moving to new locations or to increase capture level of nearby locations [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor steam deck issues 	[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a variety of graphics optimizations - overall performance should be improved 	[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes 	[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: May 28, 2024, v10014
notes.content:
[b]May 28, 2024, v10014[/b]
	[list]
	[*]New War Supplies modifier: added an additional modifier to war supplies, based on the total number of war supplies equipped across all units and war tortoise; ie, the more war supplies you have equipped globally, the stronger the next war supply will be. This is a soft push to spread your war supplies around as many units/tortoise as you can, and will now give a significant boost to not horde war supplies on just your tortoise, or only a few units. This also adds an interesting wrinkle in the order you want to upgrade your units
	[*]Players can now refresh daily fish/adventure/missions after an amount of time
	[*]Fixed an issue with mouse clicks not registering while reeling in a fish
	[*]Descriptions are now visible when viewing locked Evolutions
	[*]Fixed some bugs in adventure mode
	[*]Fixed a display bug with Ahap’s passive ability
	[*]Each Ratling General and Toad Sergeant can summon at most 10 enemies at once
	[*]Event rewards are now correctly affected by global fish bone multipliers (Navy tortoise, relics)
	[*]Added an option to turn off confirmation prompts when spending gems
	[*]Won’t auto aim in adventure mode past your weapon’s max range
	[*]Added new airship merchant which will show up every few hours to sell individual items for gems
	[*]Removed time to cook recipes; changed pack mouse ability to improve cooking strength instead of reduce cooking time
	[*]Improved Next Generation mutation strength, and standardized the display level with normal mutations (so you can directly compare their strength); Next Generation mutations now have their strength modified by your regular mutations to make sure they are better balanced between each other
	[/list]
